---
name: cohort-binding
description: Implements evidence-backed cohort proposals and dynamic role selectors for large Azure estates.
---

Combine multiple independent signals: VMSS, load-balancer or gateway pool, subnet, image, tags,
naming, deployment provenance, identity, and communication behavior. Return members, confidence,
supporting evidence, dissenting evidence, and selector proposal.

High confidence permits bulk review, not silent publication. Medium, low, conflicting, and
cross-environment candidates require explicit human resolution. Test at least 1,000 synthetic
Azure-shaped resources without requiring live VMs.
